cn_summary: DeepSeek在国庆假期前开源面向华为昇腾的基础设施组件（TileLang编译工具、高性能计算库、分布式通信库），与英伟达平台组件一一对应，性能接近硬件上限。梁文锋透露DeepSeek运营约2万块H系列算力芯片，估算训练顶级模型需5万颗GB300或20万颗昇腾950；昇腾推理芯片采购价为英伟达1/4，单卡算力比对华特供版提升2.87倍。据彭博报道，DeepSeek已向华为订购16万颗昇腾950DT用于内蒙古1GW数据中心。TileLang抽象层使模型代码可跨平台移植，DeepSeek并未与CUDA生态深度绑定。

title: Fewer Tokens, Better Action: GPT-6 Astra Robot Agents with 14% Higher Success Rate but 65% Fewer Tokens
raw_summary: Vision language model (VLM) agents can control robots through visual feedback and action primitives, but repeated model invocations and redundant observations incur substantial token overhead. We introduce PyRUA-Lean, an interactive code-execution framework that couples feedback-driven primitive composition with selective observation: the agent composes classical robot primitives and learned vision-language-action (VLA) policies into Python cells that perform conditional checks and local retries, returning only explicitly requested images and state feedback for replanning. Across 700 simulated task instances from LIBERO-PRO, RoboTwin 2.0, and RoboCasa365, we compare PyRUA-Lean with a tool-calling baseline using the same GPT-6 Astra planner and underlying robot primitives. Under equal LLM-call budgets, PyRUA-Lean increases overall success from 63.1% to 71.7%. On instances solved by both agents, it uses 49% fewer LLM calls and 65% fewer input tokens.

title: Decoding Looped Transformers Better for (Almost) Free
raw_summary: Looped Transformers achieve parameter efficiency by repeatedly executing a shared block across recurrent loops. Each loop yields an intermediate representation decodable for the same next token, yet standard decoding discards earlier states. Because earlier loops embody less computation, recurrence inherently supplies aligned weak-and-strong prediction pairs without auxiliary models or external training. We introduce LoopCD, a training-free contrastive decoding framework that guides token selection by contrasting the final prediction with an earlier recurrent pass, operating either in logit space with one extra output pass (LoopCD-Logits) or in hidden-state space with zero output overhead (LoopCD-Hidden). Across four looped Transformer families, LoopCD delivers substantial, consistent gains at full recurrent depth: LoopCD-Logits raises Ouro-2.6B-Thinking's AIME 2024 pass@1 from 61.88% to 73.33%, while LoopCD-Hidden lifts Huginn's HumanEval pass@1 from 22.56% to 31.71%. Crucially, these performance gains enable halving the number of recurrent loops while still matching or exceeding full-depth unguided baselines, reducing forward FLOPs by 22.5% to 48.2%. By transforming intermediate recurrent states into effective guidance signals, LoopCD achieves superior decoding quality while substantially reducing inference compute.
relevance_reason: LoopCD免训练对比解码框架可减少22-48%推理FLOPs，若被广泛采用将显著降低推理算力需求，间接影响算力主线判断。
cn_summary: LoopCD提出一种无需训练的对比解码框架，利用Looped Transformer循环中间态（弱预测）与最终态（强预测）的天然对齐，构建弱-强预测对来引导token选择，支持logit空间（LoopCD-Logits）和隐藏态空间（LoopCD-Hidden）两种实现。在Ouro-2.6B-Thinking上AIME 2024 pass@1从61.88%提升至73.33%，Huginn的HumanEval pass@1从22.56%提升至31.71%，且可将循环次数减半，推理FLOPs降低22.5%-48.2%，在提升质量的同时降低推理算力。
so_what: 跟踪LoopCD等推理时效率优化方案的工程化进展；若大规模部署，可抑制单次推理的算力消耗，对推理芯片需求总量形成下行压力，但同时也可能因降低使用门槛而刺激调用量增长，需观察净效应。
